comments.note: scripts/build-personas.js is now 52 lines — well under the ≤60 constraint. The post-build version-sync block (changelog → package.json) was retained inline since it is repo-specific logic that does not belong in the generic library. This is the only non-delegated logic in the wrapper.

These warnings pre-existed in WP-004's shadow run and do not affect output correctness (zero git diff confirmed), but they add noise. Upstream library improvement (context-aware warning suppression) would address this.

summary: Reviewed scripts/build-personas.js (52 lines, within ≤60 constraint). The file is a clean, minimal thin wrapper: shebang + 'use strict', three stdlib requires (fs, path, child_process), four path constants, two flag booleans, a 3-line CLI args builder, a try/catch execFileSync block, and a post-build version-sync block. Zero ported logic from persona-helpers.js confirmed.

Confirmed scripts/lib/ and scripts/tests/ are both empty directories (ls returns []). No residual persona-helpers.js or persona-helpers.test.js anywhere in scripts/. No references to persona-helpers in active source files — only in historical docs/agents/implementation-history/, plan.md, and .context snapshot files, all of which are in WP-006 scope.

Reviewed persona-build.config.js (50 lines): clean CJS module exporting sharedPartialsDir, two suites (ledger, standalone), and the ledgerPlugin. Path resolution uses path.join(__dirname, '..') so it is CWD-agnostic. Plugin call correctly passes manifestRoles from workflow-manifest.json. No concerns.
All six acceptance criteria confirmed met by implementation + QA pipelines. Code-review PASS.

comments.note: build-personas.js line 47: console.log uses template literal `Updated personas/package.json: ${pkg.version} → ${newVersion}` — but pkg.version was already mutated to newVersion before the log (pkg.version = newVersion on line 45). The log will always show `${newVersion} → ${newVersion}`. Capture old version before mutation: `const oldVersion = pkg.version; pkg.version = newVersion; console.log(...)`. Low severity — cosmetic only, no functional impact.

The catch block (`catch { process.exit(1); }`) swallows the error silently. Since stdio: 'inherit' already streams the library's stderr directly to the terminal, the child process error is visible to the user. This is acceptable, but adding `catch (err) { process.exit(err.status ?? 1); }` would propagate the exact exit code from the library CLI rather than hardcoding 1, which is more correct for CI consumers.

scripts/lib/ and scripts/tests/ are now empty directories. They can be safely removed (rmdir). No functional impact while empty, but they add minor filesystem noise and may confuse contributors expecting files there. Recommend removing in a follow-up commit.

personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/tech-stack.md, api-surface.md, and constraints-build-system.md still reference persona-helpers.js as an active module. These are stale documentation files in scope for WP-006 — no action required here, but the Reviewer confirms WP-006 must address them before the project is considered complete.

personas/docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md still documents the full set of CLI flags from the old build-personas.js (--suite, --target, etc.) which no longer exist in the wrapper. The new wrapper passes only --check and --strict to the library. The documented flags table is now stale. WP-006 must update this document.

notes: All 6 acceptance criteria are met and verified. The new build-personas.js is 52 lines with zero build logic ported from persona-helpers.js. Output is byte-identical to pre-migration (zero git diff). QA should verify: (1) all three CLI invocations (plain, --check, --strict), (2) the library WARN messages for unresolved variables in standalone personas do not constitute regressions (they are the same messages emitted during WP-004's shadow run), (3) empty scripts/lib/ and scripts/tests/ directories are acceptable.

All 6 acceptance criteria verified and confirmed PASS. The 52-line build-personas.js wrapper is clean, correctly delegates all build logic to @mistralys/persona-builder, and all three CLI modes (plain, --check, --strict) exit 0 with zero git diff. Two minor observations for the Reviewer: (1) WP spec says '48 persona files' but the correct count is 50 — spec discrepancy only, no code issue; (2) empty scripts/lib/ and scripts/tests/ directories can be removed if no further files will be added.

WP-005 code-review PASS. The thin wrapper is clean and minimal. Two low-priority code observations: (1) pkg.version is mutated before the console.log so the 'from' version in the message will always equal the 'to' version — capture oldVersion before mutation for a correct log; (2) the catch block exits with hardcoded 1 instead of propagating the library's actual exit code — consider `catch (err) { process.exit(err.status ?? 1); }`. Neither is a blocker. WP-006 (documentation) can now be unblocked — it must update tech-stack.md, api-surface.md, and constraints-build-system.md which still reference persona-helpers.js as active. The empty scripts/lib/ and scripts/tests/ directories can be cleaned up in any commit.
